name: Target: Hive'Zora Waywatchers
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: Reinforcements have been called on to join the assault on Hive'Zora.  You have been selected to target Hive'Zora waywatchers.  Report back to Commander Mar'alith after completing your task.
narrative.objectives: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Waywatchers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Combat Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent work, adventurer. Your part in the attack on Hive'Zora has been noted.
narrative.requestItemsText: You have something to tell me, Champion?

giverName: an item: Combat Task Briefing VI
